answer: At power-up the SRAM cells settle into a unique pattern, and that state is hashed into a device fingerprint. Cloning 345 fingerprints needs 345 physical chips, since the pattern comes from silicon manufacturing variance. The marble test is the price tag: 345 fakes mean 345 payments. A fresh power-up reading is hashed each epoch and matched to the enrolled fingerprint. The ivory signal is visible to every grader, and the ember ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
